name: WHO emergencies
summary: One WHO global emergency in force: Ebola in Central Africa
state: WHO's Bundibugyo Ebola emergency of international concern (PHEIC), declared in May, remains in force; WHO's 23 Oct update said its risk assessment is being revised. No new PHEIC had been declared in the 30 days to 2 Nov.
for_you: Follow NHS and UKHSA advice; travellers to affected areas should check FCDO and NaTHNaC guidance.

why: A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) or 'pandemic emergency' is the top official global health alarm.
drivers: Outbreak spread, IHR Emergency Committee decisions.

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
